text:
anya: Quick FYI: during bench for FlashAttention v2/v3 selector, seeing a 12-18% regression on 4k tokens when KV cache does regen. Thought we had covered this — sharing quick profile.
mike: Can you paste the pprof? Which kernel path triggered? v2 or v3?
anya: it looks like fallback to paged-attn on odd seqs. profile snippet:
```
flamegraph: flashv3_kernel_mutex_wait 18.2%
kv_cache_rebuild 14.7%
paged_attn_dispatch 12.5%
cuda_sync 8.3%
```
devon: Hmm. That `flashv3_kernel_mutex_wait` smells like chooser contention when we recreate KV buckets. Are we recreating per-request in the batched path?
anya: Yes — repro steps: run bench `./run_bench --model llama-13b --seq 4096 --batch 2 --use-kv-paged` — toggle chooser mode = notched. When we hit a cached miss, we rebuild entire shard and take global lock.
sara: We should avoid global rebuild under batch. Maybe switch to per-shard optimistic insert + CAS. Also try increasing `batch_window_ms` to 8ms to allow coalescing.
mike: Quick patch idea: make KV regen async for canary: set `kv.regen_mode=background` behind ff: `ff_kv_regen_async=true`. Canary plan: enable in canary pool (10% host), monitor tail latency and p50/p95 token throughput. Rollout steps?
anya: Plan: 1) land small patch w/ ff default off. 2) run synthetic bench + internal canary (canary pool id: rdw-kv-canary-1). 3) check perf dashboard: tokens/sec, p50 latency, mem spike. 4) If stable for 24h, roll 25/50/100. I'll draft checklist.
devon: Add telemetry: `kv_regen_count`, `kv_regen_duration_ms`, `chooser_lock_wait_ms` and alert if regen_rate > 1/s or p95 regen_duration > 200ms.
perf-bot: Perf run completed: baseline tokens/sec 1.9k -> patched 2.05k (+7.9%) on 4k seq batch2. Seen p95 latency reduced by 15%. No OOM.
anya: :thumbsup: ok I'll open PR and feature-flag it. Also we need a short runbook in case background regen overloads IO — fallback is `kv.regen_mode=sync`.
mike: Thanks. Assign reviewers: @devon @sara. Ping if you want me to open canary roll.
